 8.    STATUTORY MATTERS


 8.1   MONTHLY FINANCIAL STATUTORY REPORTING: DEVIATIONS FOR THE
       PERIOD 09 AUGUST 2025 UNTIL 10 SEPTEMBER 2025

Collaborator No:
IDP KPA Ref No:      Good Governance and Compliance
Meeting Date:        17 October 2025 and 23 October 2025

1.     SUBJECT: MONTHLY FINANCIAL STATUTORY REPORTING: DEVIATIONS FOR
       THE PERIOD 09 AUGUST 2025 UNTIL 10 SEPTEMBER 2025

2.     PURPOSE

       To comply with Regulation 36(2) of the Municipal Supply Chain Management
       Regulations and Section 36 of the Supply Chain Management Policy 2025/2026 to
       report the deviations to the Council.

3.     DELEGATED AUTHORITY

       Council

       For noting.

4.     EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

       Regulation 36(2) of the Municipal Supply Chain Management Regulations and Section
       36 of the Supply Chain Management Policy (2025/2026) stipulate deviations be
       reported to the Council. In compliance thereto, this report presents to the Council the
       Supply Chain Management deviations that were approved for the period
       09 August 2025 until 10 September 2025.

5.     RECOMMENDATION

       that Council notes the deviations approved for the period 09 August 2025 until
       10 September 2025.

6.     DISCUSSION / CONTENTS

6.1    Background/Legislative Framework

       The regulation applicable is as follows:

       GNR.868 of 30 May 2005: Municipal Supply Chain Management Regulations

       Deviation from and ratification of minor breaches of, procurement processes

       36. (1) A supply chain management policy may allow the accounting officer.
       (a) To dispense with the official procurement processes established by the policy
       and to procure any required goods or services through any convenient process, which
       may include direct negotiations, but only
       (i) in an emergency.
       (ii) if such goods or services are produced or available from a single provider only.
       (iii) for the acquisition of special works of art or historical objects where specifications
       are difficult to compile.
       (iv) acquisition of animals for zoos; or
                                                              10                                            Page 84
            AGENDA                       35TH MEETING OF THE COUNCIL                                            2025-10-23
                                        OF STELLENBOSCH MUNICIPALITY


                   (v) in any other exceptional case where it is impractical or impossible to follow the
                   official procurement processes; and
                   (b) to ratify any minor breaches of the procurement processes by an official or
                   committee acting in terms of delegated powers or duties which are purely of a technical
                   nature.

                   (2) The accounting officer must record the reasons for any deviations in terms of sub
                   regulation (1) (a) and (b) and report them to the next meeting of the council, or
                   board of directors in the case of a municipal entity and include as a note to the annual
                   financial statements.

            6.2    Discussion

                   Reporting the deviations as approved by the Accounting Officer for 09 August 2025
                   until 10 September 2025

                   The following deviations were approved as indicated below:

                                            Municipality                      that were not attached. The
                                            for a period                      tender was advertised for a
                                            ending 30                         period of 14 days, during
                                            June                              which three bids were
                                            20262025/08/27                    received. Two of the three
                                                                              bids received were found to

                     11                                         Page 85
AGENDA    35TH MEETING OF THE COUNCIL                               2025-10-23
         OF STELLENBOSCH MUNICIPALITY


                               be     advertised      for      a
                               minimum of 30 days and
                               National        Treasury         ,
                               Municipal              Bidding
                               Document ( MBD 5 ) , the
                               availability of funding as per
                               Circular 62 of National
                               Treasury must be approved
                               and signed off by the Chief
                               Financial Officer before any
                               bids above the estimated
                               value of R10 million can be
                               advertised       . Since the
                               tender was only advertised
                               for 14 days, the process
                               could not be concluded and
                               was therefore rendered
                               non-compliant. As this was
                               the     first     time       the
                               department issued a tender
                               of this nature, the process
                               also served as a market
                               test. The bids received
                               confirmed that the required
                               services would indeed cost
                               more than R10 million. The
                               Bid Evaluation Committee
                               (BEC) recommended that
                               the tender be cancelled on
                               this basis, and the Bid
                               Adjudication        Committee
                               (BAC)            subsequently
                               approved                    this
                               recommendation. Tender
                               B/SM 126/25 was therefore
                               formally cancelled on 29
                               August 2025. Given the
                               urgency       and     strategic
                               importance of the required
                               tourism        services        to
                               Stellenbosch Municipality,
                               and considering that the
                               two responsive bidders
                               have            demonstrated
                               compliance         and       the
                               capacity to deliver the
                               scope of work as set out in
                               the tender document, the
                               department            requests
                               approval for a deviation
                               from normal procurement
                               processes in order to
                               appoint a suitable service
                               provider for Stellenbosch
                               (Category       A    –     Visit
                               Stellenbosch)              and
                               Franschhoek (Category B –
                               Franschhoek Valley).

                               The     Bid     Adjudication
                               Committee discussed the
                               merits of following a
                               deviation    process      for
                               procuring tourism-related
                               services and resolved that
                               there are merits in doing so.

                               The Municipal Manager
                               took    note     of   the
                               recommendation       and
                               confirmed with the budget
                                           12                                    Page 86
AGENDA                     35TH MEETING OF THE COUNCIL                               2025-10-23
                          OF STELLENBOSCH MUNICIPALITY


                                                    office that VAT is exclusive
                                                    and that the quoted
                                                    amounts are within the
                                                    Budget. Furthermore, it is
                                                    important to note that
                                                    another competitive bidding
                                                    process would have been
                                                    impractical as the market
                                                    was tested already and that
                                                    we are already in the
                                                    tourism season and any
                                                    further delays will have a
                                                    negative impact on the
                                                    town. The department
                                                    needs to manage the
                                                    deliverables very strictly as
                                                    the tourism activation has
                                                    already started. Tourism is
                                                    key to job creation and it’s
                                                    an economic injection into
                                                    the town and contributes to
                                                    the GDP and economic
                                                    spin-offs of the town. The
                                                    towns of Franschhoek and
                                                    Stellenbosch               are
                                                    recognized internationally
                                                    as tourism destinations and
                                                    tourist activation becomes
                                                    key to unlock economic
                                                    activities                and
                                                    empowerment. Through the
                                                    initial tender process, the
                                                    market was tested and the
                                                    current quotations received
                                                    are within market related
                                                    prizes and we anticipate
                                                    that the municipality will
                                                    receive value for money.
                                                    This is an important
                                                    municipal function that is
                                                    delivered by the service
                                                    providers,    and      further
                                                    delays          to         the
                                                    implementation      of     the
                                                    municipal function which
                                                    leads to the non-delivery of
                                                    services.

      The regulation applicable is:

      GNR.868 of 30 May 2005: Municipal Supply Chain Management Regulations:
      Deviations from and ratification of minor breaches of, procurement processes.

      That the market may not be tested.

        The measures in place to deal with deviations mitigate the risk to an acceptable level.
